, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misread the WebSurfer’s results and incorrectly concluded the feature was “USB Wake Support.” The search snippets clearly identified Dell’s term as “USB PowerShare,” including Dell KB articles and a setup guide stating “PowerShare enables you to charge your USB devices even when your computer is turned off.” The Planner ignored this evidence and prematurely finalized the wrong term.
